title: Incorporating a church to avoid the Vietnam draft

tellings.quote: And we incorporated the Ottophilis Savonic Orthodox Church of North and South America incorporated

plain: Around 1968 in the Bronx, New York, a group of young men set up an official church, which they registered as "the Ottophilis Savonic Orthodox Church of North and South America," as a way to keep out of the military draft for the Vietnam War. The author Peter Levenda, billed on the episode as a CIA historian, tells it as something he took part in himself, a glimpse of the unusual path his early life took.
